comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body:
I personally prefer the unisex, trade-job only Senator's Costume to this outfit, as it is also +1 Spice trading but has +3 Accounts. And +1 Metal trading, if that's your thing.

Having said that, of course, producing the aforementioned Costume does require R15 Sewing, and the ingredients are somewhat uncommon. Well, it's your call as to which would be easier/serve you better, I guess.
